latest_release.name: v2026.08.12
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Pulled in `PyMuPDF` typing fix by @jamesbraza in https://github.com/Future-House/paper-qa/pull/1320
* Update j178/prek-action action to v2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Future-House/paper-qa/pull/1332
* Update astral-sh/setup-uv action to v8 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/Future-House/paper-qa/pull/1331
* Add `NemotronParseBBox.to_original_coordinates` for raw nemotron-parse output by @jamesbraza in https://github.com/Future-House/paper-qa/pull/1335
* Remove duplicated "words" in evidence-summary JSON system prompts by @chris234567 in https://github.com/Future-House/paper-qa/pull/1337

## New Contributors
* @chris234567 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Future-House/paper-qa/pull/1337

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Future-House/paper-qa/compare/v2026.03.18...v2026.08.12
